new_findings.observation: The donor configuration enables cognition by default, selects qwen2.5:0.5b on localhost Ollama, assigns a 1.3 second cognition timeout, and assigns Stop a 2.0 second event limit. The comments explicitly document the model judge as a boundary/exception to the older no-LLM-in-hooks rule.
new_findings.inference: The synchronous Stop-hook model call is not merely an orphaned implementation fragment in this donor source; it is intentionally configured as active-by-default source behavior.

new_findings.observation: cmd_hook arms one event-wide SIGALRM using the Stop limit. In the Stop path, _kognition_richten_hook executes before _gw_absicht_schreiben, architekt_governance_zug, and _statuszeile_warten. The outer _HookTimeout handler exits the event body before finally cancelling the timer.
new_findings.inference: If the event-wide timeout fires during synchronous cognition, the later Stop bookkeeping statements are skipped by control flow.

new_findings.observation: retrieval_episodes persists retrieval_id, turn_id, episode_id, causal_id, session_id, generation, and query_hash. _kognition_richten_hook selects the newest uncredited retrieval row by session_id and separately extracts the last user message from the Stop transcript. Before model judging, the source does not require equality or binding across the selected row's turn_id, episode_id, causal_id, generation, or query_hash and the transcript/user-turn being judged.
new_findings.inference: Exact causal identities exist in the donor but are not enforced at the relevance-judgment attachment boundary. Reordered or interleaved same-session processing is therefore structurally capable of pairing a judgment with the wrong retrieval round unless another unobserved invariant prevents it.

contradictions.a: Historical/top-level hook contract says no LLM calls in hooks.
contradictions.b: Current donor source intentionally enables and budgets synchronous local Ollama relevance inference inside Stop.
contradictions.resolution: Do not keep both as simultaneous canonical architecture claims. Triggerword 4 must either remove/defer the inference or explicitly replace the old invariant with a bounded non-deterministic cognition contract.

contradictions.a: Retrieval storage provides exact retrieval/turn/episode/causal/generation identities.
contradictions.b: The relevance judge attaches by newest uncredited session row plus transcript-last-user-text without enforcing those identities.
contradictions.resolution: Require an exact RetrievalJudgmentBinding before relevance credit can be applied.

contradictions.a: Stop performs deterministic/state bookkeeping after cognition.
contradictions.b: The same event-wide timeout can escape from synchronous cognition and bypass those later statements.
contradictions.resolution: Essential deterministic bookkeeping must not be downstream of optional model inference under a shared abort boundary.

frankenstein_2_design_deltas.name: HookCognitionBoundary/v1
frankenstein_2_design_deltas.requirement: Move model relevance inference out of the deterministic Stop critical path into a request-scoped GRID/work-item path, or isolate it behind an explicitly bounded optional cognition boundary that cannot suppress required Stop bookkeeping. Model output remains candidate evidence only.

frankenstein_2_design_deltas.name: RetrievalJudgmentBinding/v1
frankenstein_2_design_deltas.requirement: Before model-derived relevance can affect retrieval credit, bind the judgment to retrieval_id, turn_id, episode_id, causal_id, generation, query_hash, exact model/runtime identity, and an exact user-turn/transcript digest or equivalent replay-stable identity. Mismatch fails closed.

frankenstein_2_design_deltas.name: StopTimeoutIsolation/v1
frankenstein_2_design_deltas.requirement: Required Stop bookkeeping must complete independently of best-effort cognition timeout/failure. A cognition timeout may degrade cognition, but it must not silently suppress gateway-intent, governance, wait-state, or equivalent deterministic lifecycle writes.

triggerword4_acceptance_gates: Two same-session retrieval rounds with distinct retrieval_id/turn_id/generation identities, deliberately reordered/interleaved: relevance judgment must fail closed rather than attach to the wrong episode.
Slow/cold/unreachable local cognition: required later Stop bookkeeping must still execute and produce its normal deterministic evidence path.
Cognition disabled versus warm model versus slow/unreachable model: measure exact source/build-bound substep ordering and latency without modifying Frank's own Harness.

hypothesis: The main architectural defect is not local-model use by itself but coupling non-deterministic model inference to the deterministic Stop critical path without exact retrieval-round identity binding.
counterhypothesis: An external serialization invariant may ensure Stop executions cannot interleave and the 1.3 second sub-budget may always complete before the 2.0 second Stop alarm in deployed conditions, making wrong-round attachment and skipped bookkeeping unreachable in practice.
falsifiers: Repository/host-bound execution proves an invariant that exactly serializes retrieval creation and Stop processing and binds the selected retrieval row to the same turn before judgment.

Exact runtime probes across disabled/warm/slow/unreachable cognition demonstrate later bookkeeping cannot be skipped despite the observed Python control flow, implying an unobserved wrapper or process boundary changes semantics.
